nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. The Angular app posts the ingredients and preferences here.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Answers the app with the result.

nodes.name: Validate request
nodes.notes: Checks the request: at least one ingredient, portions 1-12, cooks 1-3, known cooking time, cuisine and diet.

nodes.name: Is valid?
nodes.notes: Splits the flow: valid requests continue, invalid ones get an error.

nodes.name: Respond with error
nodes.notes: Answers with status 400 and one clear message.
